cabbage.summary_ja: 9月の長雨と日照不足で生育が遅れて出荷が減り、10月にかけてキャベツなど葉物野菜の価格が大きく上がったと報じられています[2][3][4]。11月に入ると出荷が増え、名古屋周辺では半値近くまで下がったとも伝えられています[1][4]。
cabbage.summary_en: Reports point to long rains and low sunshine in September that delayed growth and cut shipments, pushing up cabbage and other leafy vegetable prices into October [2][3][4]. As shipments grew in November, prices around Nagoya were reported to have fallen by about half [1][4].

tomato.summary_ja: 9月には長雨と日照不足でトマトなどの野菜が高値と報じられましたが[2][3]、10月初めには平年より1割ほど安いと伝えられ[1]、11月には暖冬で安いとの報道もあります[4]。10月の値上がりの理由は、これらからははっきりしません。
tomato.summary_en: Reports described high prices for tomatoes and other vegetables in September after long rains and low sunshine [2][3], but tomatoes were about 10% below normal in early October [1] and cheap in November thanks to warm weather [4]. They don't clearly explain the October rise.

grape_shine.summary_ja: シャインマスカットは価格が下がる傾向にあり、生産者や小売が新しい品種を探していると報じられています[4]。韓国で供給過剰により価格が急落したとの報道もありますが[2]、国内の10月の値下がりの理由は書かれていません。
grape_shine.summary_en: Reports say Shine Muscat prices are trending down, with growers and retailers looking for new varieties [4]. Prices were also reported to have plunged in South Korea on oversupply [2], but the headlines don't say why prices fell here in October.

apple.summary_ja: リンゴの価格は前年より3〜4割安いと報じられています[1]。前年産は雪害と猛暑で収穫が少なく高値だったと伝えられており[3]、今年は青森県産ふじの入荷が盛んとされています[2]。
apple.summary_en: Reports say apple prices are 30–40% below last year [1]. Last season's crop was reported to be small and expensive after snow damage and summer heat [3], while this year's Aomori Fuji apples are arriving in good volume [2].

greentea.summary_en: Reports point to global matcha popularity driving up tea leaf prices, with green tea drinks rising in price from November [3][4]. AEON, on the other hand, is reported to be cutting prices of its Topvalu green tea drinks from December [1].
